tasks.short: Consult authorities on fire safety regulations

steps.what: Find and read the applicable regulation passages and case evidence in the {DOCS} source file
Consult with authorities to discuss safety regulations and recommend changes as necessary, explaining evidence and hearing objections
Write the actual recommended wording and rationale in the working {DOCS} change brief and check the full meaning against the discussion and regulation
Save the working change brief in the same {DOCS} file

tasks.design: Configure source search and a change-brief template in {DOCS} that carries exact passage references and case identifiers. The engineer reads the sources, holds the authority consultation and writes the recommendation; the tool does not interpret the law or submit a formal change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating passages and repeating references distract from the substantive consultation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed search and document fields can reduce this repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, competing safety interests and authority objections require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer defends the safety reasoning and revises it in response to challenge.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for source access and confidentiality review; consultation if required by national rules

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed document search and exact reference fields can support regulatory consultation without deciding legal applicability.

assumptions: Boundary is an exploratory consultation and its actual working recommendation brief. It is not a formal filing or adoption of a regulation. Live discussion is separate from writing; no extra report is invented after every conversation. If recommendations are only oral, remove the brief and re-estimate.

The engineer selects, verifies and captures exact regulation edition, passage and case identifiers in s1, and captures feedback and recommendation wording in s3. Document owners supply existing original sources; missing editions require manual retrieval. Templates carry identifiers only, never invent a rationale.

Test native search and templates first; already indexed searches and fields earn no new saving. Full source reading and semantic checking remain. Same-system save is negligible, represented at minimum share 1 and fully retained without author self-approval. Any later formal submission is a separate authorized final-version action.
Shares are provisional active effort, not a measured consultation baseline.
research_questions: Which repeated reference operations remain after native search is configured?

already_counted.description: Source reading, consultation and recommendation meaning checks remain in the work.

incremental.description: Maintain source editions and reference template mappings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90.2, gross=9.8; upkeep 2 gives net 7.8. Low zero where the source library and reference fields already work, so no duplicate configuration is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate fire department performance and safety rules

steps.what: Read and verify incident returns, performance definitions and applicable laws in {DOCS}, capturing the actual comparison fields and calculation rules
Transfer exact incident dates, response intervals and recorded outcomes into the evaluation {SPREADSHEET}
Calculate selected response summaries and counts under the explicit rules in {SPREADSHEET}
Evaluate fire department performance and the laws and regulations affecting fire prevention or fire safety, considering context and limits of comparisons
Record the actual evaluation conclusions and source references in {DOCS} and check every interpretation and number
Save the evaluation entry in the same {DOCS} record

tasks.design: Configure exact imports and explicit calculations in {SPREADSHEET}, carrying source references into the {DOCS} evaluation. The engineer checks original records and evaluates performance and legal applicability; neither a score nor a legal conclusion is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transcription and arithmetic can obscure the evidence behind an evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports, formulas and source-linked templates perform those defined operations.
tasks.still_hard: Incident comparability and legal relevance cannot be reduced to response averages.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer separates operational context from apparent numerical performance.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for incident access, privacy review and consultation under national rules if personnel monitoring changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact incident-field imports and explicit arithmetic can support human fire-performance evaluation.

assumptions: Representative episode actually includes manual incident tabulation and a written evaluation. Department staff produce incident returns in existing response recording; s1 reads and verifies them and captures identifiers, times, units, definitions, inclusion rules and missingness. No new clean feed or normalized categories are free.

Unknown fields remain unknown and require manual reconciliation in s1. S2 and s3 explicitly perform the proposed import and arithmetic; existing automatic imports and formulas earn no new saving. Test native configuration before custom code.

All legal reading and interpretation remain human. The output is an internal evaluation, not a regulatory determination, staff score, sent report or operational command. Saving is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. No author self-approval.
Shares and reductions are hypotheses for this evaluation episode, not observed department baselines. Consultation and data restrictions must be resolved before introducing the tool.
unknowns: Actual incident definitions and comparable fields
research_questions: Which calculations are currently manual and which require case-by-case judgement?

already_counted.description: Source capture, contextual evaluation and full written conclusion checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain mappings and test calculations after return-format or definition changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=64.1, gross=35.9; upkeep 4 gives net 31.9. Conservative case: heterogeneous returns leave only 12 points of transfer and arithmetic avoidable and no writing gain, giving 12-4=8. Context and legal interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual system requirements, contractor scope and current maintenance or test evidence in {PROJECT} and {DOCS}
Direct the purchase, modification, installation, testing, maintenance, and operation of fire prevention and protection systems through actual technical coordination with responsible staff
Observe actual system tests and work progress and judge deviations and corrective needs on site
Update actual asset-linked progress and test-observation entries in {PROJECT}, writing and checking technical meaning and retaining unresolved defects
Save the updated work record in the same {PROJECT} entry

tasks.design: Configure asset-linked work and test fields in {PROJECT} so existing identifiers do not need repeated entry. The engineer still directs the work, observes progress and writes and checks technical observations; software does not buy equipment, change a system or close a defect.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work records can repeat asset and scope details already held in the project.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked records and defaults can reduce this re-entry.
tasks.still_hard: Safe sequencing, test adequacy and contractor deviations require site knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises when actual conditions invalidate the planned work.

ambition.what: No automated control or procurement authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for asset access and site workflow review; national consultation where required

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked project records can reuse fixed work identifiers while technical supervision remains human.

assumptions: Representative episode is engineering direction of existing authorized system work, with actual project progress and test entries. It covers the engineer's coordination and observation, not contractors' physical installation or operation. Their existing labour is unchanged, not displaced or made free.

Project owners and site staff produce existing scope and asset records; s1 verifies them. S4 captures all observations, defect descriptions and links. Only exact asset/work fields default; missing or conflicting identifiers require manual entry and checking. Do not invent status evidence or automatic defect closure.

Actual formal purchase orders, contractor notices, work permits, equipment changes and commissioning releases are distinct authorized actions if present in a concrete episode; none is silently issued by a record save or by software. This coordination example must not be extrapolated to those other lifecycle phases without modelling their real actors and authority.

Test native links first; existing linking earns no new saving. Ordinary same-system save is minimum share 1, fully retained and ungated, with no invented self-approval. Shares are provisional and the actual lifecycle mix must be measured.
research_questions: Which record fields are genuinely repeated during engineering supervision?

already_counted.description: Context reading, technical direction, observation and meaningful record writing/checking remain.

incremental.description: Check asset and work-field mappings after project configuration changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94.3, gross=5.7; upkeep 2 gives net 3.7. Low zero when actual records already link assets and work, so do not introduce duplicate configuration. Site direction and test observation retain all their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend fire protection workshops and conferences

steps.what: Find relevant workshop sessions and read their agenda and technical abstracts in {DOCS}
Attend workshops, seminars, or conferences to obtain information regarding fire prevention and protection, listening and questioning speakers

tasks.design: Use native search of the event programme in {DOCS} to find sessions by topic and speaker. The engineer reads relevant abstracts and attends the sessions; the tool does not replace technical learning with a generated summary.
tasks.previous_blocker: A long programme may require repeated manual scanning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native text search and bookmarks already support topic retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding claims and asking useful questions require attention and expertise.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer tests what the presentation means for real fire protection work.

ambition.what: No new service or decision right.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-1 for programme access; no staff monitoring or clinical data

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: searching a digital event programme can reduce manual agenda scanning without replacing attendance.

assumptions: Representative episode is attendance to obtain information, not presenting an authored paper. Event organizers produce the actual programme and abstracts; s1 reads and selects them. If programme text is unavailable, manual scanning remains; no free transcription is assumed.

No report, attendance filing or post-event note is established by this statement, so none is invented. If actual attendance recording or a presentation is required, separate and evaluate its real writing and any issue step before estimating that episode.
Native search first. Existing search use earns no new saving. Shares describe hypothetical active work for this episode and do not price annual setup into every event.
unknowns: Programme format and current search use
research_questions: Does native programme search already remove repeated scanning?

already_counted.description: Programme reading and actual attendance remain.

incremental.description: Allow for checking search coverage when each programme changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94, gross=6; upkeep 1 gives net 5. Low zero when the current programme is short or already searched, so there is no additional tool setup. All actual attendance remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated reference and work-record entry; engineering judgement and site direction stay with the engineer.
reach: Fire service analyst: learn incident definitions and fair comparison limits.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish numerical summaries from safety evaluations
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who can trace performance evaluations and technical recommendations to actual evidence while continuing to direct safety work personally.
